description: Get an overview of the whole monitored x402 catalog: how many endpoints are monitored, how many fall into each verdict (proceed, caution, avoid, free, insufficient_data), and when scores were last computed. Use it for context or reporting, for example to tell a user how much of the x402 ecosystem passes checks. It says nothing about any single endpoint: use check_endpoint for one endpoint, top_endpoints for a ranked list, or check_payment before paying. Read-only, free, no parameters.
name: catalog_stats
title: x402 catalog statistics
